_note: Copy to config.json and fill in. Per-account OpenRent login + FlashProxy proxy are stored in Supabase (openrent_account_secrets) via the app UI, not here.
_note_phase2: business_id + default_proxy are ONLY needed for Phase 2 auto account-creation (persona 'Maria'). default_proxy is the shared FlashProxy base; the worker appends -session-<account id> so each created account gets its own sticky UK IP. Account creation is OFF unless account_creation_enabled is set in the openrent_settings blob.
